headline: Spots Más Largos Preferidos

Respecto a la publicidad digital, un 46.5% de encuestados por Pollfish consideraban que los anuncios de treinta segundos tenían duración perfecta, mientras que un 26.5% prefería los de quince segundos. headline: Confianza empresarial se vera afectada
content: Caída del cobre amenaza con apagar euforia por llegada de Piñera en Chile  (Bloomberg) The government of Sebastian Piñera has bet its reputation on increasing growth more than twofold since the last administrations average under Michelle Bachelet was just over 1.8%  The prices for copper fell to their lowest level in nine months, threatening to dampen enthusiasm sparked across Chile following the election victory of business-friendly president Sebastian Piñera back in December. While the impact on corporate confidence might not become apparent until later in the year, it’s already evident how much investor sentiment depends heavily upon commodity price movements.  Two victories for Piñera caused euphoria among investors which exceeded any advance seen in copper pricing – Chiles primary export – up till now. In contrast, former president Michelle Bachelet took office amid falling copper prices leading directly to diminished economic optimism during her term beginning in 2014.
